units.rawText: Once upon a time, a caregiver Doll sought a dream she held. She joined a project, for children to be never abject; for a future so bright none would reject.
units.displayText: Once upon a time, a caregiver Doll sought a dream she held. She joined a project, for children to be never abject; for a future so bright none would reject.

spans.text: Once upon a time, a caregiver Doll sought a dream she held. She joined a project, for children to be never abject; for a future so bright none would reject.

units.rawText: The project blundered, left her in a world without wonder. To no end she wandered, alone she pondered.
units.displayText: The project blundered, left her in a world without wonder. To no end she wandered, alone she pondered.

spans.text: The project blundered, left her in a world without wonder. To no end she wandered, alone she pondered.

units.rawText: To an unfamiliar world she stood, anxiety creeping underneath her foot. Around, there were no friendly faces, only enemies wishing to erase her traces. The stories she told for the young to unfold now only left her breath as whispers so cold. A frail hope she sought, a rescue, she thought.

units.rawText: Fallen to despair, she was, at last, ready to give up. But that, however, would not come to pass. A human arrived, Dolls by their side. With them she found shelter, a place she would no longer swelter... What do you think of this tale, Professor?

units.rawText: Oh my, might this be the story of me meeting Angela for the first time?

units.rawText: Yes, Professor. I felt truly safe when you came to my side and softly said, "You'll be fine." I was so touched and I couldn't help but hug you tightly back then... Hehehe.

units.rawText: I've spent so long caring for children, but I've never known what it's like to be cared for myself. Thank you, Professor—not just for saving me, but for bringing that sense of safety to the entire Oasis.

units.rawText: Every time I comfort the little agents, I tell them, "Everything will be fine when the Professor is here," or, "Don't worry, the Professor will help you." They always calm down quickly after hearing those words. It's become my magic phrase.

units.rawText: Professor, I believe you'll save everyone and overcome every obstacle, bringing the perfect conclusion to this imperfect story. Though, if you have time one day, you should come over and listen to one of my bedtime stories.
